text: APPROVE. Moving the type-dispatch into `CompareSegment` removes the nested if/else-if/else from `Compare`, which drops its cognitive complexity below the threshold. Behaviour is identical, since the mixed case's old early `return -1/1` is now a nonzero `c` that `if (c != 0) return c;` returns immediately. The new private static helper has no obvious build or warning risk, though I could not build it or check for a name clash with an existing `CompareSegment`, as the repo isn't available here.
